overview_description.description: Trayd is a construction-focused back-office platform that supports payroll, workforce management, and operational coordination for contractors. The platform combines HR management, onboarding, benefits administration, and employee record tracking within a single system, while also supporting scheduling, dispatch, and crew allocation across job sites. It includes labor tracking tools that capture time, shift activity, and field data, enabling visibility into workforce activity and job progress. Trayd also delivers payroll processing designed for complex labor environments, including union requirements, wage rules, and multi-state compliance considerations. The system generates reports and dashboards that consolidate payroll, attendance, and labor cost data, allowing users to monitor project spending and produce certified payroll documentation. In addition, it supports expense tracking, paid time-off requests, and worker onboarding workflows through digital interfaces.

about_short_description.short_description: Trayd is a back office operating system that focuses on HR, payroll, and compliance, streamlining workflows for construction companies.

product.name: Payroll
product.description: A platform for managing construction payroll with options for weekly, bi-weekly, off-cycle, and instant payments, including automated prevailing wage overrides and multi-entity support.

product.name: Scheduling and Time Tracking
product.description: Tools for creating and managing construction work schedules with geolocation-based clock-ins, auto-approvals, and real-time shift notifications.

product.name: Projects and Reporting
product.description: A system for real-time labor tracking, labor cost monitoring, customizable reports, and certified payroll reporting for construction projects.

product.name: HR and Onboarding
product.description: A platform for managing employee onboarding, tracking PTO and sick days, handling expense reimbursements, and monitoring certifications for W2 and 1099 workers.
